async def crawl_async(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> asyncio.Future[None]:
        if self.crawling:
            raise RuntimeError("Crawling already taking place")
        if self._started:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Cannot run Crawler.crawl_async() more than once on the same instance.")
        self.crawling = self._started = True
        self.spider = self._create_spider(*args, **kwargs)
        self._apply_settings()
        self._update_root_log_handler()
        self.engine = self._create_engine()
        future = deferred_to_future(self.engine.open_spider(self.spider))
        self._active.add(future)
        future = deferred_to_future(self.engine.start())
        self._active.add(future)

        async def _done(_: asyncio.Future[None]) -> None:
            self.crawling = False
            if self.engine is not None:
                await deferred_to_future(self.engine.close())
            self.crawling = False
            self._active.discard(future)
            self.bootstrap_failed |= not getattr(self, "spider", None)

        future.add_done_callback(lambda f: asyncio.create_task(_done(f)))
        return future
